\#\# Abstract\:

Large language models are transitioning from text generators to agent systems capable of autonomous decision\-making\. These systems exhibit four distinct evolutionary stages\: L1 fixed workflows \(assisted execution\)\, L2 endogenous single\-agent \(autonomous planning\)\, L3 distributed multi\-agent \(collaborative division of labor\)\, and L4 autonomous evolutionary systems \(full lifecycle closed\-loop\)\. Improvements in model capabilities primarily drive stage transitions\. When models cannot directly solve complex tasks\, three core mechanisms compensate for capability gaps\: tool invocation has evolved from regex matching to progressive context disclosure\, reasoning has advanced from single\-chain generation to dynamic planning with knowledge hypergraphs\, and memory management has shifted from passive truncation to policy network\-driven intelligent scheduling\. We propose a capability\-mechanism matching framework\: the evolution of agents from L1 to L4 essentially reflects engineering architectures that introduce three core mechanisms to compensate for model capability gaps and enable synergistic co\-evolution\.

\#\# Abstract
Autonomous agents play a crucial role in advancing Artificial General Intelligence\, enabling problem decomposition and tool orchestration through Large Language Models \(LLMs\)\. However\, existing paradigms face a critical trade\-off\. On one hand\, reusable fixed workflows require manual reconfiguration upon environmental changes\; on the other hand\, flexible reactive loops fail to distill reasoning progress into transferable structures\. We introduce Hierarchical Variable Agent \(HiVA\)\, a novel framework modeling agentic workflows as self\-organized graphs with the Semantic\-Topological Evolution \(STEV\) algorithm\, which optimizes hybrid semantic\-topological spaces using textual gradients as discrete\-domain surrogates for backpropagation\. The iterative process comprises Multi\-Armed Bandit\-infused forward routing\, diagnostic gradient generation from environmental feedback\, and coordinated updates that co\-evolve individual semantics and topology for collective optimization in unknown environments\. Experiments on dialogue\, coding\, Long\-context Q\&A\, mathematical\, and agentic benchmarks demonstrate improvements of 5\-10\% in task accuracy and enhanced resource efficiency over existing baselines\, establishing HiVA\'s effectiveness in autonomous task execution\.

\#\# Abstract\:

In the fast\-paced world of Artificial Intelligence\, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation \(RAG\) has since been a core method of making inputs of large language models \(LLMs\) more factual and relevant\. The traditional RAG systems\, however\, have a drawback that only serves to have them tend to take advantage of non\-dynamic retrieval pipelines and limited contextual reasoning\. To overcome these issues\, this paper presents an architecture of agentic RAG using various autonomous agents to route queries\, validate them\, dynamically retrieve web\-based knowledge\, and coordinate them\. The proposed system is implemented and experimentally tested with the help of a basketball information retrieval scenario\. The quantitative findings show that the agentic RAG experiences a 10\.3\% more retrieval accuracy and 16\.2\% higher relevance of responses than traditional RAG and a 31\% reduction in their consumption of tokens\. Though the orchestration adds latency slightly\, it gives much greater contextual precision and robustness to multistage queries\. The study confirms that the concept of the agentic RAG provides an alternative to the classic pipeline RAG that is scalable and intelligent and can serve as a novel pathway towards knowledge\-based AI systems\.

Date of Conference\: 24\-25 April 2026

Date Added to IEEE Xplore\: 18 June 2026

Conference Location\: Ghaziabad\, India

\#\#\# I\. Introduction

Retrieval\-Augmented Generation \(RAG\)\, which incorporates external knowledge to make large language models \(LLMs\) smarter\, has revolutionized the field of artificial intelligence\. Nevertheless\, traditional RAG has its negative aspects\, as it has mainly relied on the utilization of the vector databases to store and retrieve data chunks\. Hence\, Agentic RAG\, a more intelligent\, agent\-driven strategy\, is revolutionizing the field\. So\, a question arises\: \"Are vector databases as we know them coming to an end\?\" Not yet\, but by making information retrieval dynamic\, adaptable\, and far more efficient\, agentic RAG is pushing the envelope\.

\# A Survey of Self\-Evolving Agents\: On Path to Artificial Super Intelligence

Huan\-ang Gao Jiayi Geng Wenyue Hua Mengkang Hu Xinzhe Juan Hongzhang Liu Shilong Liu Jiahao Qiu Xuan Qi Yiran Wu Hongru Wang Affiliation\: Equal contribution and the order is determined alphabetically\, Corresponding Author Han Xiao Yuhang Zhou Shaokun Zhang Jiayi Zhang Jinyu Xiang Yixiong Fang Affiliation\: Princeton University\, Princeton AI Lab\, Tsinghua University\, Carnegie Mellon University\, Qiwen Zhao Affiliation\: University of California\, Santa Barbara\, University of California San Diego\, Dongrui Liu Qihan Ren Cheng Qian Affiliation\: University of Illinois Urbana\-Champaign\,Github Repo\: https\:\/\/github\.com\/CharlesQ9\/Self\-Evolving\-Agents Zhenhailong Wang Affiliation\: University of Illinois Urbana\-Champaign\,Github Repo\: https\:\/\/github\.com\/CharlesQ9\/Self\-Evolving\-Agents Minda Hu Huazheng Wang Qingyun Wu Heng Ji Affiliation\: University of Illinois Urbana\-Champaign\,Github Repo\: https\:\/\/github\.com\/CharlesQ9\/Self\-Evolving\-Agents Mengdi Wang Affiliation\: Equal contribution and the order is determined alphabetically\, Corresponding Author

\#\#\#\#\#\# Abstract

Large Language Models \(LLMs\) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks but remain fundamentally static\, unable to adapt their internal parameters to novel tasks\, evolving knowledge domains\, or dynamic interaction contexts\. As LLMs are increasingly deployed in open\-ended\, interactive environments\, this static nature has become a critical bottleneck\, necessitating agents that can adaptively reason\, act\, and evolve in real time\. This paradigm shift —from scaling static models to developing self\-evolving agents — has sparked growing interest in architectures and methods enabling continual learning and adaptation from data\, interactions\, and experiences\. This survey provides the first systematic and comprehensive review of self\-evolving agents\, organizing the field around three foundational dimensions — what to evolve\, when to evolve\, and how to evolve\. We examine evolutionary mechanisms across agent components \(e\.g\.\, models\, memory\, tools\, architecture\)\, categorize adaptation methods by stages \(e\.g\.\, intra\-test\-time\, inter\-test\-time\)\, and analyze the algorithmic and architectural designs that guide evolutionary adaptation \(e\.g\.\, scalar rewards\, textual feedback\, single\-agent and multi\-agent systems\)\. Additionally\, we analyze evaluation metrics and benchmarks tailored for self\-evolving agents\, highlight applications in domains such as coding\, education\, and healthcare\, and identify critical challenges and research directions in safety\, scalability\, and co\-evolutionary dynamics\. By providing a structured framework for understanding and designing self\-evolving agents\, this survey establishes a roadmap for advancing adaptive\, robust\, and versatile agentic systems in both research and real\-world deployments\, ultimately shedding lights to pave the way for the realization of Artificial Super Intelligence \(ASI\)\, where agents evolve autonomously\, performing at or beyond human\-level intelligence across a wide array of tasks\.

上证报中国证券网讯（记者 罗茂林）8月13日晚间，DeepSeek Harness团队通过官方公众号宣布，DeepSeek Harness的开发者预览版（v0\.1版本）正式面向全球开发者开放测试，并同步以MIT协议开放源代码。这是DeepSeek在智能体（Agent）赛道落下的关键一子，标志着其从大模型研发正式迈向Agent产品化落地。

据介绍，Harness是DeepSeek自主研发的开源智能体框架（agent harness）。通俗而言，DeepSeek基座大模型是智能体的“大脑”，负责推理与理解；而Harness则是“执行神经系统”——一套环绕在大模型周围的完整控制与编排系统，负责调度工具、管理任务状态和执行闭环，将模型的推理能力转化为能实际完成复杂任务的智能体。

记者注意到，DeepSeek此前在官方招聘信息中给出了一个简洁公式：“Model \+ Harness \= Agent”。

据官方披露，在架构设计上，此次推出的DeepSeek Harness最核心的原则是“一切皆插件”。它基于具有时空可组合性的Cordis插件系统构建，模型、工具、技能、会话、沙箱、存储、循环、调度、UI等所有Agent能力均由插件组合而成，可自由替换、灵活重组。开发者无需改动Harness源码本身，就能以插件方式独立选择、替换或扩展任一能力。这一设计思路意味着Harness具备极高的可定制性和可扩展性。

此外，针对不同使用场景，DeepSeek Harness提供了四种运行模式，即：标准模式、PTC模式（程序化工具调用）、极简模式以及创造模式。并且Harness还设计了仅追加（append\-only）的会话日志系统，模型看到的一切——系统提示词、思维链、工具调用与结果、子Agent调度等——均被完整记录。开发者可以在Trajectory视图中按来源追溯这些信息，并支持恢复、分叉、检索与回放。

在不少业内人士看来，此次推出的DeepSeek Harness在产品定位上对标OpenAI Codex及Anthropic Claude Code，旨在成为一款主打编程和办公场景的AI生产力工具。

值得注意的是，Harness的能力已在实际测试中得到验证。

在7月31日DeepSeek\-V4\-Flash正式版API公测中，其API文档已明确写道：Code Agent任务使用“DeepSeek Harness极简模式（即将发布）”作为测试框架。此次开发者预览版的发布，意味着这一产品正式从幕后走向台前。

据公开报道，DeepSeek Harness团队于2026年5月内部立项，由崔添翼担任负责人。崔添翼本科毕业于浙江大学计算机系，曾在量化交易机构Jane Street任职九年，2026年3月加入DeepSeek。8月2日，他曾面向全球公开征集Harness内测用户，短时间内吸引了数十名全球开发者报名。

DeepSeek发布开源智能体框架Harness开发者预览版（v0.1，MIT协议），公式“Model + Harness = Agent”：基座模型为“大脑”，Harness为“执行神经系统”，负责工具调度、任务状态管理与执行闭环。核心设计“一切皆插件”，基于具时空可组合性的Cordis插件系统，模型/工具/技能/会话/沙箱/存储/循环/调度/UI均可替换重组，无需改源码。提供标准、PTC（程序化工具调用）、极简、创造四种模式；采用append-only会话日志，完整记录提示词、思维链、工具调用与子Agent调度，支持Trajectory视图追溯及恢复、分叉、检索、回放。对标OpenAI Codex与Claude Code，主打编程与办公生产力。

**2. 可迁移点**
- 多智能体：子Agent调度与append-only轨迹记录，便于编排与审计。
- 自进化：插件热替换、会话分叉回放，支撑能力迭代与经验复用。
- 知识管理：全量轨迹可检索回放，形成可追溯记忆。
- 检索增强：工具调用结果结构化留存，利于RAG溯源。

**3. 风险/局限**
预览版成熟度未知；插件组合带来兼容与安全风险；日志全量留存涉隐私与成本；对标产品竞争激烈，生态待验证。
